text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The opposition Malawi Congress Party (MCP) and Alliance for Democracy (Aford) said they were boycotting byelections in Blantyre City Centre. An application to the High Court askeing for the poll to be postponed was going ahead.
- Staff at the Electricity Supply Commission of Malawi have told politicians to stop interfering with its day-to-day business.
- Judgment is expected in a High Court application to stop Blantyre City Centre byelections should eight hours after voting starts.
- Tobacco sales stopped for a second day on Wednesday because of farmers' dissatisfaction with low prices.
- Staff at Lilongwe international airport warned airlines they would land at their own risk because of a strike by civil servants.
